info.title: Billing & Debt Recovery API
info.description: API for managing debtors, billing attempts, uploads, VOP verification, BAV, chargebacks, EMP accounts, reconciliation, and admin operations.

get.description: Returns the 50 most recent BAV batch records ordered by creation date.

post.summary: Upload a CSV file to create a BAV batch
post.description: Uploads a CSV file, auto-detects IBAN and name columns, validates the structure, and returns a preview of the first rows. The batch is created in 'pending' status and must be started separately.

422.description: Validation error or CSV parsing failure

error.example: Could not detect IBAN column. Ensure CSV contains valid IBANs.

post.description: Confirms and queues a pending BAV batch for processing. Optionally accepts a record_limit to process only a subset of records. Checks BAV credit balance before starting.

record_limit.description: Max number of records to process (defaults to all)

message.example: BAV batch queued for processing (100 of 500 records)

422.description: Batch already started or insufficient credits

error.example: Not enough BAV credits. Need 100, have 50.

get.summary: Get BAV batch status and progress
get.description: Returns the current processing status and progress of a BAV batch. If the batch is currently processing, it refreshes the progress data before returning.

get.summary: Download BAV batch results as CSV
get.description: Downloads the results CSV file for a completed BAV batch. The file includes original data plus appended BAV verification columns: bav_valid, bav_name_match, bav_bic, bav_score, bav_result, bav_error.

404.description: Batch not found or results not available yet

get.description: Returns the current BAV API credit balance including remaining and total credits.
Returns the current BAV credit balance including remaining credits, total credits, expiration status, and usage history.

get.summary: Get BAV verification stats for an upload
get.description: Returns the number of eligible debtors for BAV verification, current credit balance, and whether verification can be started.

post.summary: Start BAV verification for an upload
post.description: Starts BAV verification for eligible debtors in the upload. Debtors are chunked into jobs and dispatched as a Laravel batch. Requires sufficient BAV credits and non-expired subscription.

get.summary: Get BAV verification progress for an upload
get.description: Returns the current BAV verification progress including processed count, total count, and status. Combines database state with cached progress data.

post.summary: Cancel BAV verification for an upload
post.description: Cancels an in-progress BAV verification by cancelling the Laravel batch and marking the upload BAV status as failed. Clears cached progress data.
Allows an admin to manually adjust the total and used BAV credits. Logs the adjustment with the requesting user's email.

get.description: Returns aggregated transaction metrics per BIC (bank) for risk monitoring. Includes transaction counts, volumes, chargeback rates, and high-risk flags. Results are cached for 15 minutes.

parameters.name: tether_instance_id
parameters.description: Filter by Tether instance (takes priority over emp_account_id)

parameters.name: cb_reason_code
parameters.description: Filter chargebacks by specific reason code

get.description: Returns transaction metrics grouped by amount and currency for a specific BIC. Useful for identifying which price points have the highest chargeback rates.
Returns chargeback counts and volumes grouped by reason code for a specific BIC. Shows percentage distribution of each code relative to total chargebacks.

get.summary: Get summary for a specific BIC
get.description: Returns aggregated transaction metrics for a single BIC including approval rates, chargeback rates, volumes, and risk status.

404.description: BIC not found or no data

error.example: BIC not found or no data

post.description: Clears all cached BIC analytics data across all periods and billing models. Use after data corrections or when fresh calculations are needed.

get.description: Downloads BIC analytics data as a CSV file. Accepts the same filters as the index endpoint. Filename reflects applied filters and period.
Returns a paginated list of billing attempts with optional filters by upload, debtor, status, billing model, and free-text search across transaction IDs, debtor names, emails, and IBANs.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Filter by billing model ('all' returns unfiltered)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search across transaction_id, unique_id, debtor name, email, IBAN

get.description: Returns detailed information for a specific billing attempt including related debtor and upload data.

post.description: Creates a new billing attempt by retrying a failed one. Only attempts with status 'declined' or 'error' can be retried.

201.description: Retry initiated, new billing attempt created

message.example: This billing attempt cannot be retried

500.description: Retry failed due to server error

get.description: Returns the count of 'clean' debtors — those with approved charges, no lifetime chargebacks, and not charged in the last X days. Supports broad mode (>=1 approved) and strict mode (>=2 approved).

parameters.name: min_days
parameters.description: Exclude debtors charged in last N days

get.description: Exports clean users data. For small exports (<=10,000 records) returns a streamed CSV directly. For larger exports, queues a background job and returns a job ID for polling.

parameters.name: min_days
parameters.description: Exclude debtors charged in last N days

202.description: Export queued as background job (when limit > 10,000)

message.example: Export queued. Use job_id to check status.

get.summary: Get clean users export job status
get.description: Returns the status and progress of a queued clean users export job. When completed, includes a download URL.
Downloads the CSV file for a completed clean users export job. Streams the file from S3 storage.

404.description: Export not ready or file not found

message.example: Export not ready or not found

post.description: Queues a void job for all approved/pending transactions of an upload. Only transactions within the last 24 hours can be voided. For resynced uploads, only the latest run's transactions are voided.

422.description: Cannot void (too old or no eligible transactions)

message.example: Cannot void transactions older than 24 hours. Please use Refund instead.

post.summary: Cancel active billing for an upload
post.description: Sets a termination signal that running billing jobs check to stop execution. Works for both initial syncs and resyncs. Clears all sync lock keys.

message.example: Termination signal sent. The sync will stop shortly.

post.summary: Start billing sync for an upload
post.description: Dispatches billing jobs for eligible debtors. Supports billing model filtering (all, legacy, flywheel, recovery). For uploads with cooldown disabled (is_30d_cool=false), triggers resync flow with automatic run archival. Validates VOP completion before allowing billing. Prevents duplicate syncs via cache locks. Respects billing caps and excludes conflicting billing model debtors.

200.description: No eligible debtors or resync completed without dispatch

422.description: Cannot start billing (VOP incomplete, voiding, invalid model, resync denied)

message.example: VOP verification must be completed before billing. 50 debtors pending verification.

get.summary: Get billing statistics for an upload
get.description: Returns aggregated billing attempt statistics grouped by status, including counts and amounts. Indicates whether billing or resync is currently processing.
Returns a paginated list of chargebacked billing attempts with debtor and account details. Includes aggregated chargeback statistics (total count, amount, rate, top reason code) in the response meta.

parameters.name: tether_instance_id
parameters.description: Filter by Tether instance (takes priority over emp_account_id)

parameters.name: date_mode
parameters.description: Date field to filter on: transaction date or chargeback date

get.summary: Get all unique chargeback reason codes
get.description: Returns a list of all distinct chargeback reason codes found in billing attempts. Cached for performance.

get.summary: Get chargeback reason breakdown for an upload
get.description: Returns a summary of billing vs chargeback stats for the upload, plus a breakdown of chargeback reason codes with counts, amounts, and percentages. Excludes configured reason codes.

200.description: Upload chargeback summary and reason breakdown

get.summary: Get chargeback records by reason code for an upload
get.description: Returns a paginated list of chargebacked billing attempts for a specific upload and reason code. Includes debtor details and EMP account info.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Chargeback reason code (use 'null' for records without a code)

get.description: Returns a comprehensive dashboard with upload stats, debtor stats (by status, country, IBAN validity), VOP verification stats, billing stats (by status, approval/chargeback rates, amounts), recent activity (uploads and billing), and 7-day trends. All sections support filtering by tether_instance_id or emp_account_id, and billing/debtor sections support month/year filtering.

parameters.name: tether_instance_id
parameters.description: Filter by Tether instance (takes priority over emp_account_id)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of debtors with optional filters by upload, status, validation status, country, risk class, billing model, and free-text search across names, emails, and IBANs.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Filter by billing model ('all' returns unfiltered)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search across first_name, last_name, email, IBAN, iban_masked

get.description: Returns detailed debtor information including upload, debtor profile, EMP account, VOP logs, billing attempts, and latest VOP/billing data.

put.description: Updates debtor fields including raw_data (auto-maps to debtor fields via FIELD_MAP), billing model (creates/updates/removes DebtorProfile), email, status, and risk_class. Re-runs validation after update.

raw_data.description: Key-value pairs that auto-map to debtor fields (iban, first_name, last_name, email, amount, etc.)

model.description: Change billing model (creates/updates DebtorProfile or removes it for legacy)

post.description: Runs the full validation pipeline on a debtor: required fields, name format, IBAN validity and SEPA check, amount range, email format, country, encoding, BIC resolution, and blacklist check. Updates validation_status and validation_errors.

post.summary: Bulk reassign debtors to a different EMP account
post.description: Reassigns debtors and their unsent pending billing attempts (no unique_id) to a target EMP account. Attempts already submitted to EMP (have unique_id) or in final states are left unchanged. Runs in a database transaction.

message.example: Reassigned 3 debtors to Primary Account. 1 pending attempts already submitted to EMP were left unchanged.

422.description: Target account is not active or validation error

message.example: Target EMP account is not active.

get.description: Returns the count of debtors attached to non-existent or soft-deleted uploads.

delete.description: Permanently removes all debtors that are attached to non-existent or soft-deleted uploads.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of transaction descriptors ordered by default status and date. Each descriptor defines the text that appears on a debtor's bank statement for SEPA transactions.

post.description: Creates a new transaction descriptor. If marked as default, any existing default for the same EMP account scope is automatically unset. Supports global defaults (emp_account_id=null) and per-account defaults.

get.description: Returns a specific transaction descriptor by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing transaction descriptor. If marked as default, any other default for the same EMP account scope is automatically unset. Invalidates descriptor cache.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a transaction descriptor and invalidates the descriptor cache.

post.description: Dispatches an async job to sync transaction data from EMP for a given date range. Can target a single EMP account or all accounts. Only one refresh can run at a time. Date range is limited to 90 days.

emp_account_id.description: Specific EMP account to refresh (null = all accounts)

422.description: Validation error (date range exceeds 90 days, no accounts configured)

get.description: Returns the current status and progress of a specific EMP refresh job by its UUID. Includes sync stats (inserted, updated, unchanged, errors) and per-account progress.
Returns whether an EMP refresh is currently running, along with its progress and stats. Use this for polling the UI refresh indicator.

post.description: Queries the EMP gateway for the current status of a pending billing attempt and updates it accordingly. Only pending attempts with a unique_id and fewer than 10 reconciliation attempts are eligible. Automatically handles chargeback blacklisting and debtor status updates.

message.example: This billing attempt cannot be reconciled

post.summary: Reconcile all eligible attempts for an upload
post.description: Queues a reconciliation job for all pending billing attempts in the upload that have a unique_id, are older than 2 hours, and have fewer than 10 reconciliation attempts.

message.example: No eligible billing attempts to reconcile

get.description: Returns system-wide reconciliation stats including total pending, stale (48h+), never reconciled, maxed out attempts, and currently eligible count.

get.summary: Get reconciliation stats for an upload
get.description: Returns reconciliation statistics for a specific upload including total attempts, pending count, eligible for reconciliation, and count reconciled today. Also indicates if reconciliation is currently processing.

post.description: Queues a bulk reconciliation job for pending billing attempts across all active EMP accounts. Only one bulk reconciliation can run at a time. Eligible attempts must be pending, have a unique_id, be older than 2 hours, have fewer than 10 reconciliation attempts, and be within the specified max age.

max_age_hours.description: Only reconcile attempts created within this many hours (default 720 = 30 days)

limit.description: Maximum number of attempts to process (default 1000)

message.example: Bulk reconciliation queued for 150 billing attempts across 2 EMP accounts

200.description: No eligible attempts or no active accounts

message.example: No eligible billing attempts to reconcile

get.description: Returns transaction statistics grouped by country with chargeback rates. CB rate formula: chargebacks / approved * 100 (EMP-aligned). Supports period, monthly, billing model, and account filtering. When date_mode is 'chargeback', rates are not calculated (only counts).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month (1-12), used with year for monthly filtering

parameters.name: date_mode
parameters.description: Filter by transaction date or chargeback date

get.description: Returns chargeback counts and amounts grouped by reason code. Excludes configured reason codes. Results are cached.
Returns transaction and chargeback statistics grouped by bank name (from VOP logs). Includes per-bank chargeback rates and alert flags when rates exceed the configured threshold.

get.summary: Get chargeback statistics by price point
get.description: Returns transaction and chargeback statistics grouped by billing amount. Shows which price points have the highest chargeback rates. Includes approved and chargeback volumes.

Returns chargeback statistics grouped by reason code across all time, with percentage breakdowns relative to total chargebacks and total approved+chargebacked records. Excludes configured reason codes.
Returns all Tether instances with their associated acquirer (EMP) account. Used for the admin panel instance selector dropdown. Optionally filter to active instances only.
Returns a paginated list of uploads with debtor counts, validation stats, billing stats (approved/chargeback counts and amounts). Supports filtering by status and account.

post.description: Uploads a CSV/XLSX file, pre-validates headers (IBAN, amount, name required), auto-maps columns, and creates debtor records. Small files (<100 rows) are processed synchronously; larger files are queued. Supports billing model selection, EMP account/Tether instance assignment, global IBAN lock, cooldown, and chargeback check skip.

message.example: File queued for processing. Check status for updates.

get.description: Returns detailed upload information including uploader, EMP account, Tether instance, debtor counts (valid, invalid, BAV stats), billing amounts, ready-for-sync counts, and enriched billing run history with per-run recovery stats.

delete.description: Hard-deletes upload and S3 file if no debtors exist. Soft-deletes upload and debtors if no billing attempts exist. Returns 403 if billing attempts exist.

get.description: Returns current processing progress for an upload including record counts and completion percentage.
Returns a paginated list of debtors belonging to the upload. Supports filtering by billing model, validation status, chargeback exclusion, and text search.

post.description: Dispatches validation jobs for all debtors in the upload. Resets validation state for unbilled debtors. Optionally updates skip_bic_blacklist and skip_chargeback_check flags before validating.

get.summary: Get validation stats for an upload
get.description: Returns detailed validation statistics including counts by status, billing model breakdown, blacklisted/chargebacked counts, price point breakdown with CB rates, and resync state.

post.summary: Reassign upload to a different EMP account
post.description: Reassigns the upload, all its debtors, and unsent pending billing attempts to a new EMP account. Submitted attempts (with unique_id) are left unchanged. Runs in a transaction.

422.description: Target account inactive or already assigned

patch.description: Updates configurable upload settings such as max_billing_amount (billing cap per debtor).

get.summary: Get billing cycles for an upload
get.description: Returns billing attempt statistics grouped by attempt_number (cycle) and status, with total billed amount and billing cap remaining.

post.description: Soft-deletes all debtors in the upload that have at least one chargebacked billing attempt.

get.description: Returns up to 5 uploads matching the filename query. Results are cached for 5 minutes.

patch.description: Enables or disables the 30-day cooling period. Only applicable to Legacy billing model uploads. Disabling cooldown enables resync functionality.

get.summary: Get VOP verification stats for an upload
get.description: Returns VOP verification statistics for an upload including total eligible debtors, verified count, pending count, breakdown by result, average score, and processing status. Supports filtering by billing model.

post.summary: Start VOP verification for an upload
post.description: Dispatches a VOP verification job for all eligible debtors in the upload. Uses IBAN-based deduplication to avoid redundant API calls. Optionally force-refreshes all verifications.

force.description: Force re-verification of all debtors, ignoring cache

post.summary: Verify a single IBAN via BAV API
post.description: Performs a single BAV (Bank Account Verification) check for an IBAN and name pair. Returns name match result, BIC, and VOP score. Can use mock mode for testing without consuming credits.

use_mock.description: Use mock response instead of real API

get.summary: Get VOP logs for an upload
get.description: Returns a paginated list of VOP verification logs for the upload, with debtor name and IBAN. Ordered by most recent first.

Returns a paginated list of VOP verification logs with debtor and upload relations. Supports filtering by upload, debtor, result, BAV verification status, and text search across BIC, masked IBAN, and debtor IBAN.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search across BIC, masked IBAN, and debtor IBAN

get.description: Returns detailed VOP verification log with debtor and upload relations.
Returns a paginated list of webhook relay configurations with their associated EMP accounts. Each relay proxies incoming webhooks from a custom domain to a target URL.

post.description: Creates a new webhook relay with a custom domain and target URL. Associates it with one or more EMP accounts. Automatically provisions an SSL certificate and deploys the Nginx proxy configuration to the remote relay server.

put.description: Updates an existing webhook relay's domain, target URL, and EMP account associations. Re-deploys the Nginx proxy configuration after update. If the domain changed, provisions a new SSL certificate.

delete.description: Deletes a webhook relay and redeploys the Nginx configuration to remove the proxy block from the remote relay server.

post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Returns one of three possible states: direct authentication (no 2FA), 2FA setup required (first time — includes backup codes), or OTP required (standard 2FA flow — sends OTP to email).
Completes the 2FA setup after the user has saved their backup codes. Returns a bearer token upon success. Only valid when the user's 2FA status is 'setup required'.
Verifies the 6-digit OTP code sent to the user's email during login. Returns a bearer token upon success. Codes expire after a configured time and have a maximum attempt limit.
Verifies a single-use backup code for account recovery when OTP is unavailable. Each backup code can only be used once. Returns a bearer token upon success.
Resends a new OTP code to the user's email. Invalidates any previously sent code. Rate limited to 5 requests per 15 minutes.

message.example: Too many OTP requests. Please try again later.

post.description: Revokes the current access token.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's basic information.
Returns all EMP merchant accounts ordered by sort_order. Includes basic info and monthly cap.
Returns the EMP account currently set as active. Only one account can be active at a time.

post.summary: Set an EMP account as active
post.description: Deactivates all other EMP accounts and sets the specified one as active.

get.description: Returns transaction statistics for a specific EMP account including counts by status, total approved amount, chargeback amount, and chargeback rate.

get.summary: Get monthly caps and usage for all EMP accounts
get.description: Returns monthly cap, used amount, remaining capacity, usage percentage, transaction count, and 90-day chargeback gross percentage for each EMP account. The 90-day window is anchored to the end of the selected month (or today for current/future months).

put.summary: Update monthly cap for an EMP account
put.description: Sets the monthly billing cap for a specific EMP account. Set to 0 to remove the cap.

post.description: Receives webhook notifications from the emerchantpay payment gateway. Validates the signature, deduplicates events, and queues processable events (chargebacks, retrieval requests, SDD status updates) for async processing. Returns an XML echo response with the unique_id as required by EMP to acknowledge receipt and prevent retries. Protected by EmpWebhookSecurity middleware — does not use Bearer auth.

400.description: Missing unique_id or other validation error

BicAnalyticsRow.description: Aggregated transaction metrics for a single BIC

Chargeback.description: Chargebacked billing attempt with debtor and account details

Debtor.description: Individual debt record with validation, VOP, and billing state

debtor_profile.description: Debtor profile with billing model (when loaded)

Descriptor.description: Transaction descriptor defining bank statement text for SEPA transactions

DescriptorInput.description: Input for creating or updating a transaction descriptor

descriptor.description: Text that appears on debtor's bank statement

month.description: Specific month (1-12) or null for default

year.description: Specific year or null for default

is_default.description: Whether this is the default descriptor for its scope

Upload.description: File upload with debtor records, validation, billing, and resync state

WebhookRelay.description: Webhook relay proxy configuration that routes incoming webhooks from a custom domain to a target URL

WebhookRelayInput.description: Input for creating or updating a webhook relay

target.description: Target URL to proxy webhooks to

emp_account_ids.description: EMP accounts to associate with this relay

VopLog.description: VOP (Verification of Payee) verification log entry

bearerAuth.description: Login via /api/login, then pass the token as: Bearer {token}

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Authentication, 2FA setup, OTP verification, login/logout

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Admin dashboard overview with aggregated stats across uploads, debtors, VOP, billing, and 7-day trends

tags.name: Stats
tags.description: Chargeback statistics by country, reason code, bank, and price point with configurable period/model/account filters

tags.name: BIC Analytics

tags.name: Uploads

tags.name: VOP

tags.name: VOP Logs
tags.description: VOP verification log entries with filtering by upload, debtor, result, BAV status, and text search

tags.name: BAV

tags.name: BAV Batches
tags.description: Standalone BAV batch verification — CSV upload with auto-detect columns, batch processing with deduplication, progress polling, and results download

tags.name: Billing

tags.name: Billing Attempts
tags.description: Individual billing attempt management — listing with filters, retry failed attempts, and single attempt details

tags.name: Clean Users
tags.description: Clean users export — debtors with approved charges, no lifetime chargebacks, and not recently charged. Supports streaming and async export

tags.name: Reconciliation
tags.description: Transaction reconciliation with EMP gateway — single attempt, per-upload, and bulk reconciliation with progress stats

tags.name: EMP
tags.description: EMP merchant account management — list/activate accounts, monthly caps with usage tracking, inbound refresh sync, and 90-day chargeback stats

tags.name: Tether Instances
tags.description: Tether instance listing for admin panel instance selector — includes acquirer account association

tags.name: Chargebacks
tags.description: Chargeback records with statistics — list with filters, unique reason codes, per-upload reason breakdown, and per-code record drill-down

tags.name: Debtors
tags.description: Debtor CRUD — listing with filters, update with field mapping and billing model changes, validation, orphan cleanup, and bulk EMP account reassignment

tags.name: Descriptors
tags.description: Billing transaction descriptors — bank statement text management with per-account and global defaults, month/year targeting

tags.name: Webhook Relays
tags.description: Webhook relay proxy configuration — custom domain to target URL routing with SSL provisioning and Nginx deployment

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: External webhook endpoints — EMP gateway notifications with signature verification, deduplication, and async processing
